_note: Player skills (docs/design/equipment_skills_robots.md section 2; the curve is docs/design/quests_levels_story.md section 2). scope player: each player has their own; farm: one shared by the whole farm, which no skill is now (Robotics and Husbandry became each player's own, and a save from before gives every player on it the farm's XP once: docs/design/quests_levels_story.md section 9, step 4). level_curve: going from level n to n + 1 costs base_xp × growth^(n − 1), so total XP to reach level n = round(base_xp × (growth^(n − 1) − 1) / (growth − 1)). effect_share: how much of an effect's full cut a level has, in straight lines between the rows. calibration_tier_xp: XP from a calibration is multiplied by the entry for the tier of the standard used (Tier 0 first). effects: full is the cut at the top level, as a fraction of the base; what is left is never under floor. unlocks: the level that shows more. old_curve is only for converting a save from the 10-level curve (total = base_xp × (n − 1) × n / 2): its XP is multiplied by xp_factor, and old_per_level under each effect is what one old level cut. Every number is a [PLACEHOLDER]; the xp_sources are today's ×5, right for levels 1 to 25 only and not yet tuned to the hour budget. calibrate_robot and calibrate_robot_player replace calibrate_player for a robot's sensor. A source with per gives its xp for each of those, rounded to a whole XP: job_done for every finished paid job and job_clean too when it was on time and traceable, both by the credits paid after any cut; harvest_in_spec for a crop harvested in spec and sell_crop for a sale to Lin, both by what Lin pays for the crops before fronted seed is taken out [PLACEHOLDER]. crop: the source is crop work. Its XP went to Field Ops before Agronomy was a skill, and each player's total from these is kept (GameState.action_counts), which is how a save from then has it moved to Agronomy as it loads. till gives Agronomy XP from now on and is not marked crop: what it gave Field Ops before stays there. Earthworks is earned by dig, for each step a cell goes deeper than it has been before (GameState.dug_paid, so digging and filling the same cell gives it once), and find_block, for a gauge block dug up; fill, place_stone and check_with_block give none yet [PLACEHOLDER]. An effect with a full below 0 is a gain, not a cut: lin_price is what Lin pays the seller for a crop, 10 % more at Agronomy 99 [PLACEHOLDER]; the XP of harvest_in_spec and sell_crop is by the price without it. Earthworks has no effect yet. lab_xp_sources feed the lab level, not a skill (docs/design/quests_levels_story.md section 3.2): one XP total for the whole farm on the same curve, earned by anyone's work in the lab; every value is a [PLACEHOLDER]. lab_calibration is a traceable calibration by a player and lab_robot_calibration one by a robot, both times calibration_tier_xp and only when the instrument was not calibrated too soon; buy_standard and calibrate_standard (a standard calibrated on the bench by a player, on top of lab_calibration) are times calibration_tier_xp too, and were the Instrumentation skill's sources; lab_job is for every finished paid job, by the credits paid; lab_clean_audit a clean audit; lab_certificate a standard back from OIRM with its certificate; lab_spool a spool collected or slotted; lab_robot a robot built, and again when it is commissioned; lab_area a lab area fitted and lab_grown the lab made bigger. lab_level/size_xp: every lab XP source is multiplied by the entry for the lab's size (the ids of economy.json lab/sizes) [PLACEHOLDER]. lab_gates is the unlock table of quests_levels_story.md section 3.4, every level [PLACEHOLDER]: a row opens when the lab level reaches level AND the condition the game already had holds (needs says it in plain words, for the phone; the condition itself stays in code and its own data). built false is a row whose thing does not exist yet: it gates nothing and is there so the order and the hours can be tuned. beat marks a story beat, which must sit at or below level 60. quest names the lab quest that is the provisional way through a row (section 3.2.1): the row's thing is offered below its level, and finishing that quest pays lab_level.provisional_gap_share [PLACEHOLDER] of the lab XP still missing to the level, on top of its own. band on accredited_jobs is the credibility band whose jobs wait for that row. A save from before the gates keeps what it had open (GameState.lab_gates_kept). tests/test_lab_gates.gd prints about how many hours each row takes. Zone rows (docs/design/zones.md section 7.2, build step 3) are all built:false and gate nothing; the Lava Tubes 5 row is the warning level only, the tunnels are never walled. Levels are [PLACEHOLDER].
